title: Not Ready Yet
description: A dispatcher tries to download a scheduled report the instant they create it, before the queued job has had any chance to run. The download endpoint needs to say "not yet" clearly rather than serving a blank or broken file.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs as a dispatcher returns 202 with job.status "pending". Immediately (before the queue delay elapses, within ~50ms), GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id/download for that job's id returns 409 with error.code CONFLICT and a message stating the job's current status. After waiting past NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS (default 500ms), GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id shows status "ready", and GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id/download now succeeds with 200 and Content-Type text/csv.
hints: The report job queue is the same queue notifications use — the default delay is documented in docs/self-host.md.

Poll GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id rather than blindly sleeping a fixed amount if you want a more robust test — but the immediate-409 assertion specifically needs you to act before any delay, so don't poll for that first part.
